summary:
`runList` now takes an optional filter, and the list tests pass. The command-line flags `--done` and `--todo` still don't work end to end, because the parsing belongs to `src/cli.ts`, which is outside this node.

## What changed

**`src/commands/list.ts`**
- `runList(dir, filter = 'all')` now accepts `'all' | 'done' | 'todo'`. Calling `runList(dir)` behaves as before.
- With `'done'` it lists only completed items; with `'todo'` only incomplete ones.
- The summary line (`共 N 项，已完成 M 项。`) is always computed over all todos, so filtered output still shows the overall totals.
